finding.summary: The public JSON Schema accepts raw credential material after two-pass percent decoding that the runtime and authoritative store reject before append.
finding.scope: Nine independently generated cases cover fully encoded JSON, mixed/double encoded JSON keys, mixed/double encoded client-secret assignments, a mixed/double encoded URL, a mixed/double encoded provider prefix, and a percent-encoded private-key marker.
finding.runtimeResult: All nine normalizeMetadata and createConnectionStore probes returned CONNECTION_CREDENTIAL_MATERIAL; every store probe appended zero events.
finding.publicSchemaResult: Ajv 2020 validation of the same event shape returned true for all nine cases.
finding.source: Runtime decodes two bounded passes at packages/connections/src/schema.mjs:681-699,722-733; the public percent helper is limited to patterns at packages/connections/src/schemas/connection-events.v1.schema.json:73-97 and credential values at :132-150.
